notes: KNBS 2019 KPHC Vols I-IV tabulate down to sub-county (Vol I/III/IV) and division/location/sub-location (Vol II Table 2.4) but NOT by county assembly ward. No official 2019 ward-level population was found; ward population fields are null by design.

Nyamira CIDP 2023-2027 (maarifa.cog.go.ke copy) has no ward population table; it gives sub-county census figures and 2022/2025/2027 KNBS projections (Table 4, p.10: county 653,515 in 2022, 665,477 in 2025, 672,337 in 2027 - projections, not census).

CIDP 2023-27 Table 5 (age cohorts, p.10) reproduces 2019 census 5-year groups that match Vol III; its 'Total' row in Table 13 (special age groups) double-counts overlapping groups (1,296,299) and should not be cited.

Sub-county to constituency mapping (CIDP 2023-27 s.1.4.3, p.9): Nyamira South = West Mugirango; Manga + Masaba North = Kitutu Masaba; Nyamira North = North Mugirango EXCEPT Kiabonyoru division (43,830 people, Vol II) which belongs to Borabu constituency; Borabu SC = Borabu constituency remainder. Hence Borabu constituency 2019 pop could be derived as 73,167 + 43,830 = 116,997 and North Mugirango as 167,267 - 43,830 = 123,437 - derived arithmetic, label as such, and only valid if division and constituency boundaries coincide exactly (CIDP says they do).

Census admin divisions in Manga SC (Kemera 40,647, Magombo 23,295, Manga 30,267) and Masaba North SC (Gachuba 30,781, Gesima 35,633, Rigoma 45,446) share names with the six Kitutu Masaba wards, but division=ward coincidence is NOT confirmed by any source found. Counter-evidence that name matches are not ward populations: Bogichora location has 19,381 residents while CIDP 2018-22 shows 19,430 registered voters in Bogichora ward.

IEBC 2022 registered voters by ward: not found in accessible IEBC PDFs (IEBC ECVR summaries for Nov 2021 and Feb 2022 are county-level only; Nyamira new registrations in ECVR II as at 6 Feb 2022 = 14,342). voters2022 left null. Earlier-register ward figures (CIDP 2018-22 Table 7, 'IEBC 2018', county total 278,853 registered, 553 polling stations) recorded in separate fields.

Rural/urban split from Vol II Tables 2.2a/2.2b: rural 558,540, urban 47,036 (KNBS urban definition). CIDP 2023-27 Table 6 instead claims urban population 195,815 (Nyamira Municipality 155,572 + Keroka 18,482 + Nyansiongo 21,761) - these are the CIDP's aggregations of admin units (Keroka = Keroka Township location; Nyansiongo = Nyansiongo location), not KNBS urban counts; do not mix.

Vol I county total population 605,576 includes 13 intersex; Vol III age table total is 605,563 (intersex excluded). Vol I households 150,669 (incl. 170 group quarters); Vol IV indicator denominators are 150,499 conventional households.
